page.content:
Co-founder and first CEO, the PayPal alum who designed the early brand.

How Chad Hurley connects

  • Topic: YouTube — Chad Hurley co-founded YouTube and served as its first CEO.
  • Item: YouTube Play Button — Hurley's play-button mark became the physical award's silhouette.

What is Chad Hurley?

Chad Hurley co-founded YouTube with Steve Chen and Jawed Karim, served as CEO through the Google sale, and remained the public designer of the play-button logo.

Key threads lead to YouTube and YouTube Play Button.
